ucs.title: [LLM] BlackByte BYOVD: RTCore64.sys driver-load chained to EDR/AV process termination
ucs.description: Hunts BlackByte's hallmark 'Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver' tradecraft — the actor drops the MSI Afterburner RTCore64.sys (CVE-2019-16098) signed driver and uses it from a custom EDR-killer to kill 1000+ AV/EDR processes before deploying the ransomware. CrowdStrike (TRG / 'AcidPour'/AcidRain unrelated) and Microsoft (DEV-0506/0823 cluster) both attribute this driver+killer pattern to BlackByte.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.file_hash) as file_hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="RTCore64.sys" OR Filesystem.file_name="rtcore64.sys" OR Filesystem.file_hash IN ("01aa278b07b58dc46c84bd0b1b5c8e9ee4e62ea0bf7a695862444af32e87f1fd","e32a8c5dfffd45d6c5dfa6c2e1057c1c4e1fbe6c95f64a3a09fb6f5b1d5b1b40")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="sc.exe" OR Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*RTCore64*" OR Processes.process="*create*RTCore*" OR Processes.process="*sc*start*RTCore*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name _time | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` ] | where lastTime - firstTime < 1800 | table firstTime lastTime dest user file_path file_name parent_process_name process_name process | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let DriverWrite = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "RTCore64.sys"
        or SHA256 in~ (
            "01aa278b07b58dc46c84bd0b1b5c8e9ee4e62ea0bf7a695862444af32e87f1fd",
            "e32a8c5dfffd45d6c5dfa6c2e1057c1c4e1fbe6c95f64a3a09fb6f5b1d5b1b40"
        )
    | project DriverTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverPath=FolderPath, DriverHash=SHA256,
              DriverWriter=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DriverWriterCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DriverWriterUser=InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let ServiceCreate = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "sc.exe"
         or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("New-Service","sc create","sc start"))
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "RTCore"
    | project SvcTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              SvcCmd=ProcessCommandLine, SvcUser=AccountName;
DriverWrite
| join kind=inner ServiceCreate on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', DriverTime, SvcTime)) <= 30   // 30m = empirical install→service window for BlackByte EDR-killer
| project DriverTime, SvcTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', SvcTime, DriverTime),
          DeviceName, DriverWriterUser, DriverWriter, DriverWriterCmd,
          DriverPath, DriverHash, SvcCmd
| order by DriverTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let DriverWrite = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where TargetFileName endswith "RTCore64.sys"
         or TargetFileSHA256 in~ (
            "01aa278b07b58dc46c84bd0b1b5c8e9ee4e62ea0bf7a695862444af32e87f1fd",
            "e32a8c5dfffd45d6c5dfa6c2e1057c1c4e1fbe6c95f64a3a09fb6f5b1d5b1b40"
         )
    | project DriverTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              DriverPath=TargetFilePath, DriverHash=TargetFileSHA256,
              DriverWriter=ActingProcessName,
              DriverWriterCmd=ActingProcessCommandLine,
              DriverWriterUser=ActorUsername;
let ServiceCreate = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\sc.exe"
         or (NewProcessName has_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\cmd.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("New-Service","sc create","sc start"))
    | where CommandLine has "RTCore"
    | project SvcTime=TimeGenerated, Computer,
              SvcCmd=CommandLine, SvcUser=SubjectUserName;
DriverWrite
| join kind=inner ServiceCreate on $left.DvcHostname == $right.Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', DriverTime, SvcTime)) <= 30
| project DriverTime, SvcTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', SvcTime, DriverTime),
          Host = DvcHostname, DriverWriterUser, DriverWriter,
          DriverWriterCmd, DriverPath, DriverHash, SvcCmd
| order by DriverTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: BlackByte BYOVD - RTCore64.sys Vulnerable Driver Drop
id: 9b1e1d3a-2c4f-4b1a-9c2f-4d5b8a6c1e2f
status: experimental
description: Detects write of the MSI Afterburner RTCore64.sys driver abused by BlackByte ransomware for EDR/AV process termination via CVE-2019-16098.
references:
    - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/blackbyte-ransomware-disables-edr-via-rtcore64-byovd/
    - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2022/05/09/ransomware-as-a-service-understanding-the-cybercrime-gig-economy/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
    - attack.defense_evasion
    - attack.privilege_escalation
    - attack.t1068
    - attack.t1562.001
    - g1043
logsource:
    category: file_event
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_name:
        TargetFilename|endswith: '\RTCore64.sys'
    selection_hash:
        Hashes|contains:
            - '01aa278b07b58dc46c84bd0b1b5c8e9ee4e62ea0bf7a695862444af32e87f1fd'
            - 'e32a8c5dfffd45d6c5dfa6c2e1057c1c4e1fbe6c95f64a3a09fb6f5b1d5b1b40'
    filter_legit:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\MSIAfterburner.exe'
            - '\MSI Afterburner Installer.exe'
        Image|contains: '\Program Files\MSI Afterburner\'
    condition: (selection_name or selection_hash) and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate MSI Afterburner installations outside the standard Program Files path
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\RTCore64.sys OR *\\rtcore64.sys OR *\\RTCORE64.SYS) OR @Hashes:(*01aa278b07b58dc46c84bd0b1b5c8e9ee4e62ea0bf7a695862444af32e87f1fd* OR *e32a8c5dfffd45d6c5dfa6c2e1057c1c4e1fbe6c95f64a3a09fb6f5b1d5b1b40*)) -@Image:(*\\MSIAfterburner.exe OR *\\MSI?Afterburner?Installer.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| (TargetFileName=/\\RTCore64\.sys$/i OR SHA256HashData=/^(01aa278b07b58dc46c84bd0b1b5c8e9ee4e62ea0bf7a695862444af32e87f1fd|e32a8c5dfffd45d6c5dfa6c2e1057c1c4e1fbe6c95f64a3a09fb6f5b1d5b1b40)$/i)
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\MSIAfterburner\.exe$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 CommandLine=/RTCore/i (ImageFileName=/\\sc\.exe$/i OR ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i)}, field=aid, include=[ComputerName, CommandLine, ImageFileName, UserName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] BlackByte ExByte staging: MEGA exfil tool + BlackByteRestore ransom note within the same host within minutes
ucs.description: BlackByte's exfiltration tool 'ExByte' (Go-compiled, ~1.5MB) connects to api.mega.co.nz / mega.nz with hard-coded MEGA SDK credentials before BlackByte itself encrypts files and writes BlackByteRestore.txt. Catching the ExByte→ransom-note→.blackbytent extension chain on a single host inside a 60-minute window confirms an active BlackByte intrusion (DEV-0506 / 'Hecamede').
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as exbyteTime values(Processes.process) as exbyte_cmd values(Processes.user) as exbyte_user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="ExByte.exe" OR Processes.process="*ExByte*" OR (Processes.process="*api.mega.co.nz*" OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*")) AND Processes.parent_process_name!="MEGAsync.exe" by Processes.dest Processes.process_name | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as noteTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as note_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("BlackByteRestore.txt","BB_Readme.txt","BlackByteWarn.txt") OR Filesystem.file_path="*.blackbytent" OR Filesystem.file_path="*.blackbyte" OR Filesystem.file_path="*.bb") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name ] | eval window_minutes=(noteTime - exbyteTime)/60 | where window_minutes >=0 AND window_minutes <= 60 | table exbyteTime noteTime window_minutes dest exbyte_user exbyte_cmd note_path | sort - exbyteTime
ucs.kql:
let ExByteStage = union DeviceProcessEvents, DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FileName =~ "ExByte.exe")
         or (ProcessCommandLine has "ExByte")
         or (RemoteUrl has_any ("api.mega.co.nz","mega.nz","mega.io") and InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MEGAsync.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe"))
    | project ExbyteTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              ExbyteUser = coalesce(AccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountName),
              ExbyteProc = coalesce(FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName),
              ExbyteCmd  = coalesce(ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
              ExbyteDest = RemoteUrl;
let RansomNote = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ ("BlackByteRestore.txt","BB_Readme.txt","BlackByteWarn.txt")
         or FolderPath has_any (".blackbytent",".blackbyte")
         or (ActionType == "FileRenamed" and FileName endswith ".bb")
    | project NoteTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              NoteName=FileName, NotePath=FolderPath,
              NoteWriter=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NoteWriterCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
ExByteStage
| join kind=inner RansomNote on DeviceId
| where datetime_diff('minute', NoteTime, ExbyteTime) between (0 .. 60)
| extend GapMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', NoteTime, ExbyteTime)
| project ExbyteTime, NoteTime, GapMinutes, DeviceName, ExbyteUser,
          ExbyteProc, ExbyteCmd, ExbyteDest,
          NoteName, NotePath, NoteWriter, NoteWriterCmd
| order by ExbyteTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let ExByteStage = union
    (ImProcessCreate
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where ActingProcessName endswith "ExByte.exe"
             or ActingProcessCommandLine has "ExByte"
        | project ExbyteTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
                  ExbyteUser=ActorUsername,
                  ExbyteProc=ActingProcessName,
                  ExbyteCmd=ActingProcessCommandLine,
                  ExbyteDest=""),
    (ImWebSession
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
        | where Url has_any ("api.mega.co.nz","mega.nz","mega.io")
        | where SrcUsername !in~ ("") and HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent !has "MEGAsync"
        | project ExbyteTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname=SrcHostname,
                  ExbyteUser=SrcUsername,
                  ExbyteProc="", ExbyteCmd="", ExbyteDest=Url);
let RansomNote = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where TargetFileName in~ ("BlackByteRestore.txt","BB_Readme.txt","BlackByteWarn.txt")
         or TargetFilePath has_any (".blackbytent",".blackbyte")
    | project NoteTime=TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              NoteName=TargetFileName, NotePath=TargetFilePath,
              NoteWriter=ActingProcessName,
              NoteWriterCmd=ActingProcessCommandLine;
ExByteStage
| join kind=inner RansomNote on DvcHostname
| where datetime_diff('minute', NoteTime, ExbyteTime) between (0 .. 60)
| extend GapMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', NoteTime, ExbyteTime)
| project ExbyteTime, NoteTime, GapMinutes, Host=DvcHostname,
          ExbyteUser, ExbyteProc, ExbyteCmd, ExbyteDest,
          NoteName, NotePath, NoteWriter, NoteWriterCmd
| order by ExbyteTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon ((@EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\ExByte.exe OR *\\exbyte.exe OR *\\EXBYTE.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*ExByte* OR *exbyte*))) OR (@EventID:3 @DestinationHostname:(api.mega.co.nz OR *.mega.nz OR *.mega.io) -@Image:(*\\MEGAsync.exe OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe))) OR (@EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\BlackByteRestore.txt OR *\\BB_Readme.txt OR *\\BlackByteWarn.txt OR *.blackbytent OR *.blackbyte)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\ExByte\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/ExByte/i)) OR (#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(api\.mega\.co\.nz|.*\.mega\.nz|.*\.mega\.io)$/i NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(MEGAsync|chrome|msedge|firefox|brave)\.exe$/i) OR (#event_simpleName=FileWritten (TargetFileName=/\\(BlackByteRestore|BB_Readme|BlackByteWarn)\.txt$/i OR TargetFileName=/\.(blackbytent|blackbyte|bb)$/i))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, DomainName, TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName])])
| (lastSeen - firstSeen) < 3600000   // 60-minute correlation window
| _count >= 2
